newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CALLARD TOO MUCH OF A HANDFUL FOR WESTERN SAMOA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CALLARD TOO MUCH OF A HANDFUL FOR WESTERN SAMOA.

text.p: Captain Jon Callard amassed 26 points as English club champions Bath proved too much of a handful for Western Samoa on Monday.

The full-back, dropped when Bath made their European Cup exit at Cardiff last month, stroked five penalties and three conversions and scored a sparkling injury-time try which capped an immaculate individual display in a 36-17 win.
With Callard finding his goalkicking range early, Bath established a valuable 20-point first-half cushion while Samoa struggled.
Prop Kevin Yates ploughed over for the opening score, then referee David Chapman punished visiting full-back Mark Fatialofa whose blatant late body-charge denied wing Jason Robinson a certain try.
Callard's penalty try conversion put Bath out of sight, although Samoa staged a spirited fightback.
Fatialofa made amends for his earlier indiscretion when he claimed two quality tries inside 10 minutes. But Bath regrouped and another successful Callard kick gave them precious breathing space.
